landing.poe1Desc: Before interacting with the simulator, formulate your theoretical hypothesis based on quantum principles.

landing.poe3Desc: Compare numerical simulation data with your prediction and consolidate conceptual mastery through graded challenges.

modules.title: Learning Modules
modules.subtitle: Each module contains a detailed KaTeX theoretical lesson, instructor slides, an interactive simulation, and leveled challenges.

m1.title: Introduction to Modern Physics
m1.desc: Failure of classical physics, blackbody radiation, ultraviolet catastrophe, and Planck's quantization hypothesis.

m2.title: Photoelectric Effect and Compton Scattering
m2.desc: Radiation-matter interaction, work function, cutoff frequency, photon-electron collisions, and Compton scattering.

m3.title: Wave-Particle Duality and De Broglie
m3.desc: De Broglie hypothesis, electron diffraction, thermal de Broglie wavelength, and Heisenberg's uncertainty principle.

m4.title: 1D Schrödinger Equation
m4.desc: Fundamental postulates, time-dependent and independent equations, Born's probabilistic interpretation, and probability current density.

m5.title: Free Particle and Wave Packets
m5.desc: Plane wave solutions, spectral superposition, temporal dispersion of Gaussian wave packets, and Ehrenfest's theorem.

m6.title: 1D Potentials and Bound States
m6.desc: Infinite and finite square wells, energy quantization via boundary conditions, eigenfunction parity, and barrier penetration.

m7.title: Quantum Tunneling and Barriers
m7.desc: Step and rectangular barrier, transmission and reflection coefficients, quantum tunneling effect, and alpha decay.

m8.title: Dirac Formalism and Quantum Algebra
m8.desc: Hilbert spaces, Bra-Ket notation, Hermitian operators, commutators, generalized uncertainty relation, and state bases.

m9.title: Quantum Harmonic Oscillator
m9.desc: Analytic treatment using Hermite polynomials and algebraic ladder operator method (creation and annihilation).

m10.title: Hydrogen Atom and Central Potential
m10.desc: Separation of variables in spherical coordinates, spherical harmonics, radial Laguerre functions, and orbital structure.

m11.title: Angular Momentum and Spin
m11.desc: Orbital angular momentum commutation algebra, electron spin 1/2, Pauli spin matrices, and magnetic dipole moments.

m12.title: Stern-Gerlach Experiment and Addition
m12.desc: Sequential quantum measurement, state collapse, spin superposition, and Clebsch-Gordan coefficients in angular momentum addition.

m13.title: Perturbation Theory
m13.desc: Time-independent perturbations for non-degenerate and degenerate cases, and the Stark effect.

m14.title: Time-Dependent Perturbations
m14.desc: First-order transition amplitudes, periodic perturbations, resonance, absorption, emission, and Fermi's golden rule.
